info.description:
Explicit proxy to Routeware WebRW. Session cookies are stored in a Worker Durable Object; clients do not send Routeware credentials.

**Customer:** `customers-read` lists rows; `detail-full` loads one record; `customer-types-read` feeds dropdowns; `add-new-long` and `load-long-modal` return the same HTML/JS shells the SPA uses before save; `save-long-form` creates or updates (URL-encoded form body). **Anti-forgery** for `save-long-form` is filled server-side from Routeware modal HTML when the client omits `__RequestVerificationToken` (see `CUSTOMER_SAVE_AUTO_TOKEN`). Routeware does not support HTTP DELETE for customers — use `save-long-form` with `Enabled=false` to disable. `DELETE /api/v1/routeware/customer` documents that limitation (returns 405 + problem+json).

**D1 snapshots (Routeware custom CSV reports):** `customer_snapshot` (CustomerID) → `address_snapshot` (PickupAddressID, CustomerID) → `container_snapshot` (ContainerID, PickupAddressID). **Export source:** set `*_REPORT_EXPORT_PATH` (static URL) **or** `*_REPORT_QUERY_ID` (WebRW: client `requestID` + `GET` `QueryExecuteDownload`), then `POST /api/v1/data-snapshot/sync` (bearer) or the daily cron. `POST /api/v1/...-snapshot/import` accepts a raw CSV body. See `CUSTOMER_SNAPSHOT.md` for setup and migration commands.

**Data entity (`/api/v1/data/*`, tag `data-entity`):** bearer = `CUSTOMER_SNAPSHOT_SYNC_SECRET`. `GET` reads nested D1 snapshots (customer + address + container graph) with ETag/cache. `POST` applies changes to Routeware, returns ids + sync outcome only (never submitted fields or the upstream body), then refreshes D1 from `GetCustomerDetailFull` and invalidates that cache for affected ids.

get.description: Routeware addresses (`PickupAddressID` → `CustomerID`). Optional filters: `customerId`, `pickupAddressId`, `ids`, exact `routeId`, `franchiseId`, stored `zip`, `city` and `state`, and case-sensitive `streetAddress` (all exact stored street matches, not city/ZIP or partial-street matches), free-text `q` over street, city or zip (a match in any one column), literal stored `driverNote` substring on `driver_note` only (not comments/locality), `enabled`, stored `extrasAllowed`, mirrored-child `hasContainers`, exact stored `lastAuditDate` equality and stored `hasLastAuditDate` presence on `last_audit_date`, and `parentCustomerEnabled` on the related stored customer's `enabled` (independent of the site's own `enabled`). Supplied filters intersect by AND; null scope columns do not match supplied values. City/state/street-only equality, driverNote-only substring and audit-date-only reads may scan without a dedicated index; none is added. No geography inference, normalization, note interpretation, audit-compliance/scheduling/overdue meaning or operational scheduling/accuracy claim. Stored text is mirrored data, not permission to act. This GET is idempotent and local-read. Pass `cursor` (the previous page's `nextCursor`) instead of `offset` to page deep result sets by primary-key seek instead of a scanned OFFSET; `upperId` caps either traversal.

Each exact selector requires a non-whitespace character, preserves leading zeros and nonblank whitespace, and never normalizes data. `q` stays a substring search and excludes state. Unscoped exact-location/locality filters scan stored rows; no dedicated location/state/zip index or production performance claim. This GET is idempotent and local-read. Optional `serialNumber` and `rfid` are case-sensitive opaque exact strings (1..100 Unicode code points); leading zeros and nonblank whitespace are preserved. Optional `onCall` and `gpsLocked` select stored `oncall`/`gps_locked` states (`true` is stored 1, `false` is stored 0, `any` adds no predicate). Optional `materialStream` matches `c.ud_material_stream_ud` and `color` matches `c.color`: case-sensitive opaque stored labels with the same nonblank 1..100 Unicode code-point bounds, no trimming, normalization or inferred taxonomy. Optional `serviceCodeType` matches `c.service_code_type` and `serviceCodeInput` matches `c.service_code_input`: case-sensitive opaque stored service-code entry text with the same nonblank 1..100 Unicode code-point bounds, no trimming, normalization, service-history inference or controlled taxonomy; mirrored report data only. Optional `parentRouteId`, `parentFranchiseId` and `parentEnabled` scope only the parent address's scalar route_id, franchise_id and enabled state through one shared address join (also used by customerId). Parent state is independent of equipment `enabled` and customer state; never parse equipment route_ids/frequency_ids as parent assignments. Effective parent selectors exclude missing/null parents; omission or parentEnabled=any alone preserves unjoined orphan visibility. All supplied filters compose with AND; null identifiers/labels do not match and duplicate matches are paginated, not collapsed. Valid unknown labels return an empty 200. Equality filters may scan; no index or performance guarantee is implied. Pass `cursor` (the previous page's `nextCursor`) instead of `offset` to page deep result sets by primary-key seek instead of a scanned OFFSET. Optional `hasSerialNumber` and `hasRfid` select by stored identity-text presence: exact `true|false|any` (default `any`) where present means the stored column `IS NOT NULL AND <> ''` and nonempty whitespace-only text counts as present. The two controls AND-compose with each other and with exact `serialNumber`/`rfid`; an exact value plus its presence=`false` yields an empty 200, while omission/`any` adds no predicate. Stored identity text is mirrored report data, never a live tag scan, deployment proof or uniqueness guarantee; missing text includes report gaps, not only untagged equipment. Failed or timed-out observations return fixed code and next_action fields and remain cached until expiry. Config and bearer checks are never cached. get.description: Lists the UTC dates holding an R2 archive for one table, newest-first, from the date-manifest sidecars (`snapshots/YYYY-MM-DD.manifest.json`). Each entry carries the manifest's recorded byte length and sha256 (hashes/sizes only, never row data). `limit` caps the page at 1..366 (default 30); `truncated` is true when possibly more dates exist — the page filled, the 366-manifest scan budget exhausted, or the R2 list truncated. Zero archives is 200 with an empty list, never 404. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <CUSTOMER_SNAPSHOT_SYNC_SECRET>`. The ETag is a content hash of the served JSON bytes, and `If-None-Match` with the current tag returns 304.

get.description: Streams the newest Routeware CSV archived to R2 for one table, resolved through the `snapshot-latest/{table}.json` pointer the sync leg republishes after every archive — no date discovery needed. The referenced history CSV is re-encoded exactly as the explicit-date download re-encodes it: records are split as the importer splits them, blank data records are dropped as its row parsers drop them, and each cell is trimmed and escaped as the export escapes it (a formula-leading cell gets an apostrophe inside quotes; plain numbers are unchanged), and a `_shadow_csv_encoding` column with value `1` follows the archived columns on every row. Rows end in LF. The stored object is not modified. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <CUSTOMER_SNAPSHOT_SYNC_SECRET>`. Returns 404 when the pointer or the CSV it names is missing, 500 when the pointer is unreadable. The ETag is a content hash of the served bytes, and `If-None-Match` with the current tag returns 304. Operators compare the download with a fresh `...-snapshot/export` by business values, not bytes.

access.full: SHADOW_API_TOKEN or CUSTOMER_SNAPSHOT_SYNC_SECRET passes the outer gate; the read token cannot authorize non-GET requests.
access.read: GET: SHADOW_API_READ_TOKEN, SHADOW_API_TOKEN or CUSTOMER_SNAPSHOT_SYNC_SECRET passes the outer gate.
access.sync-secret: CUSTOMER_SNAPSHOT_SYNC_SECRET only: the same bearer must pass both the outer and inner privileged gates, including on GET.

effect.local-read: Reads local D1, R2 or configuration; no upstream data request.
effect.local-write: Writes local D1 state without writing Routeware; imports may also archive to R2.
effect.none: No application data access (liveness or unsupported-operation response).
effect.upstream-read: Reads Routeware, including POST reads; may establish or renew the upstream session.
effect.upstream-read-local-sync: Reads Routeware reports and synchronizes local D1 state; may archive to R2.
effect.upstream-write-local-refresh: Writes Routeware and attempts a best-effort local D1/cache refresh; not an atomic or guaranteed refresh.
